entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with the product. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Don't play games with me. It's my preference that it's junk! The whole interface is completely confusing. I've tried everything, even read the stupid user manual, and it's still so hard to use. I really expected more from VeloFit. This is unacceptable.

I understand your frustration. The new interface can have a bit of a learning curve. Could you tell me which feature you're having trouble with? For example, to view your sleep data, are you swiping left from the main screen?

I'm not doing a tech support session with you! I've had it for almost two weeks and I hate it. Are you going to process my return, or do I need to speak to your manager right now? I'm one click away from telling everyone on social media how terrible this thing is.
Okay, I understand completely. No need for that. Let me pull up your account and I can certainly check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.
Alright, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered twelve days ago. Let me just confirm our policy...
Okay, yes. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you're well within the timeframe.
So you're giving me a full refund? No restocking fees or any of that garbage?

That's correct. A full refund. I'm processing the return for you now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label momentarily. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued.
Fine. That's all I wanted in the first place. Make sure that email comes through.
I've just sent it. It should be in your inbox now. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
